summaryJa: 2024年11月（文書は日付の一部を秘匿）に、特別捜査官(SA)らが過去3年間の未確認航空現象(UAP)の報告と映像を確認するために市民宅を訪問した。天候は約48°F（約9°C）、曇りで降水なし。午後4時45分頃に北側パティオで観察を開始し、最初に遠方の定常的な光を確認した後、約20分後に北端付近で白色の脈動光が木立上または木立付近の高度で横方向に不規則に動き、約10秒で消失するのをSAが観察した。住宅西側の樹林帯では、樹上で白／青色に脈動する静的な光や、数秒間広がる光芒の後に赤または白の閃光が不規則に移動して消える現象も観察された。SAは写真を5枚撮影したがぶれており、後に三脚等の安定した支持が必要と判断した。午後5時30分頃には別のSA2名が、池の遠端上方で明るい赤い光の下に明るい白い光があり、樹頂高さで右から左へ素早く移動して消え、元の位置に同時再出現して再び移動・消失する挙動を目撃。当該活動は約午後6時10分まで観察され、午後6時15分に現場を離れた。
summaryEn: In November 2024 (partial date redacted), Special Agents (SAs) visited a resident to confirm reports and video of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (UAP) reported over the prior three years. Weather at the time was about 48°F, overcast, no precipitation. Around 4:45 pm agents went to the north patio and noted distant lights; about 20 minutes later an SA observed a white pulsating light at the northern edge of the area, moving horizontally with somewhat erratic motions at or below tree-line altitude for less than ten seconds before disappearing. Additional observations from the treeline west of the residence included white/blue pulsing lights that appeared more stationary and broad plumes of light followed by red or white flashes that moved erratically. Five photos were taken but were mostly blurry; agents concluded a tripod or stable platform was needed. At approximately 5:30 pm two agents observed a bright white light above a bright red light over the far end of a pond, hovering near treetop height, moving quickly right-to-left, disappearing and simultaneously reappearing at the initial location before repeating; observation continued until about 6:10 pm, and agents departed around 6:15 pm.
